## Checklist

- [ ] The CI's checks pass locally (`cargo fmt`, build, tests and Clippy, including the runtime's optional features).
- [ ] A change that reaches the engine was tested in a project, and with the engine harness where it applies.
- [ ] A change game developers see updates the game developer's handbook.
- [ ] Every new `unsafe` block has a `// SAFETY:` comment, and no game-facing API needs `unsafe`.
- [ ] Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] No art or media asset is committed (meshes, textures, materials, sounds, animations, particles, images).
- [ ] I have the right to submit this under the MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses, and it contains no Unreal Engine source code.
